description: Audit a domain's DNS against what Google Workspace expects: MX to Google (smtp.google.com, or the legacy aspmx hosts Google still supports), SPF includes _spf.google.com, a DKIM key at the default google selector (google._domainkey), DMARC policy and rua=, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI. Built from the same envelopes check_spf, check_dkim, check_dmarc, check_mx, check_mta_sts, check_tls_rpt and check_bimi return, so it never disagrees with them. `verdict` is configured / configured_with_issues / not_detected. A domain with no Google Workspace indicator (MX, SPF include, google DKIM key) returns only GWS_NOT_DETECTED (status info). A check that could not run is listed in GWS_CHECK_INCOMPLETE and its `analysis.checks[]` entry is `unknown`, never "missing". No key at the google selector is a warning, not a failure, because an admin can choose another prefix: call check_dkim with that selector. Findings include GWS_SPF_NO_GOOGLE_INCLUDE, GWS_SPF_INVALID, GWS_DKIM_DEFAULT_SELECTOR_NOT_FOUND, GWS_DKIM_KEY_WEAK, GWS_DMARC_MISSING, GWS_DMARC_NOT_ENFORCING, GWS_MX_NOT_GOOGLE, GWS_MTA_STS_MISSING, GWS_TLS_RPT_MISSING_UNDER_ENFORCE and more (registry: resources/read mcp://tamingdns/resources/finding-codes). Read-only.

domain.description: Apex domain to inspect, e.g. "google.com". No scheme, no path.

name: check_google_workspace
title: Google Workspace DNS Checker
